# Plan: context-ceiling

Goal: Keep interactive sessions short without losing continuity: when a session's context passes a ceiling, sofar tells it to write back and /clear, so the next session resumes from the record. The ceiling, the warning point and the behaviour are settings the user can change. The statusline shows cost per call (context size), not only cache share. Evidence: splen 29 Sep-13 Oct, 91 of 152 sessions peaked >300K and held 94.7% of cache reads; top sessions ran to 966K. Zero model calls.

Brief: the operator's words, 2366 chars, verbatim in brief.md; `sofar show brief¶<k>` prints one paragraph.

Progress: 9/10 tasks done (90%)
